title: Patch 1.12: New Hands, New Routes
body:
Patch 1.12 · October 8, 2026
New Hands, New Routes

The block has 31 new collectibles: 30 characters and Black Air Fade 1’s support. Sunday Dinner, Fitness routes, Music tours and Community crews gain new ways to build a gang. The collection now reaches 298 cards, with fresh character art and a full roster balance pass. Open this patch letter in Mailman to claim 10 Street Pack Tickets.

Buffs
• Setup and support bodies gain +1 printed Hand: Dance Circle Captain, Krump, Foodz, Side Chick, Corner Coach, BBL Nice, Crazy Ex-Boyfriend, Lash Tech, Fein, BBL Demon, Red Pill, Stoner Sr., Suga Mama, The Work Hubby, Apartment Maintenance Sage and The Janky Promoter.
• The Rapper now plays at 2 Motion / 3 Hands. The OG Rap Legend now plays at 4 Motion / 5 Hands, giving Music crews earlier access to their engine and finisher.
• Fitness Girl can reward an ally with +1 Hand after a successful move when nobody needs recovery. Personal Trainer’s three-district circuit stays available through the next two rounds.
• Dance Circle Captain accepts different friendly movers to build a destination. Corner Coach can give your weakest other local ally +1 Hand when no safe coaching target is present.
• GUAP’s stats, abilities and upgrades are unchanged.

Changes
• 31 new collectibles include the Sunday Dinner family, Track Suit Auntie, Gym Bag YN, Stairwell Sprinter, Last Set OG, OG Calisthenics, Tour Van Driver, Mixtape Cousin, Merch Table Hustler and the new neighborhood crew. Each collectible has three training upgrades.
• Try four ten-card recipes: Sunday Dinner, Fitness Routes, Music Tour and Community Table. Auto Build recognizes Family and Community anchors.
• Community Cook restores lost Hands and gives Homeless recipients Protection. Night Bus Driver and Delivery App Cyclist help crews reach another district.
• Naija Scammer summons Fake Marriage during play. Fake Marriage is a summon token, not a separate pullable card. Black Air Fade 1’s is a support card that prepares an ally for its next move.
• New and revised character art gives runners, musicians, drivers, cooks and tricksters distinct silhouettes and props. Last Set OG and Merch Table Hustler use their new supplied designs; OG Calisthenics keeps his newspapers, leaves and wind.
• Claim 10 Street Pack Tickets from this release letter. One gift per account; claiming the same letter again does not grant extra tickets.
